errors.evidence: Description states the curve starts below the baseline and rises rapidly, but it actually starts at a low point near 1 before quickly rising above the baseline.
The description fails to mention that the curve actually starts slightly above the baseline at the very beginning and then descends, which is not accurately reflected in the trend description.
Description inaccurately interprets the x-axis range; it reports specific numeric labels as evenly spaced when visually they are not.
The description does not clarify that there is a horizontal baseline that serves as a reference point for the emotional changes.
